Report a random disk signature to Windows. Useful if the disk image contains a zeroed-out disk signature or you are attempting to mount a duplicate disk signature. (Requires an existing valid master boot record.)

Mount the disk image as a writable disk device. Modifications will be written to a write-overlay differencing file and the original disk image will not be changed. (Sometimes referred to as write-overlay or write-copy mode.) Currently not supported for raw/dd-type disk images.
